# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_LEVEL_REJECTION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps up >0.4% at open and retraces to test the gap-fill level (prior close), a bearish rejection candle (close < open with upper wick ≥2× body) at that level often precedes a continuation of the gap fade. This setup captures fade momentum by requiring specific rejection structure at the gap-fill level, distinct from continuation patterns like GAP_AND_GO.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Calculate overnight gap% = (open - previous close)/previous close. If gap% > 0.4%, monitor price until it touches within 0.05% of the prior close (gap-fill level). On the bar where price reaches this zone, if the bar closes below its open (bearish) and its upper wick length is ≥2× its body length, enter short at the next bar open.  
**Exit:** Initial stop is the high of the rejection candle. Target is 2× risk (ATR-based, using ATR(14) from prior day) OR exit when price falls below (previous close - 0.2%). If neither hits, trail stop at 15% above the lowest low since entry. Exit all contracts at stop or target hit.
